meta.title: apptivity.id — Apps for Every Activity | Indonesian Software House
meta.description: Apptivity (PT Lawson Semesta Indonesia) is a software house built on a win-win trilogy: affordable, transparent, friendly IT solutions for SMEs, professionals, government, and state-owned enterprises.

hero.sub: Helping anyone whose problems can be solved with IT solutions — at affordable, low, and transparent prices.
hero.waText: Hello apptivity.id, I'd like to discuss a project. Could you share more info?

about.title: Affordable, transparent, friendly IT solutions.
about.body1: Apptivity is a software house that helps anyone facing difficulties that can be solved with IT solutions, at affordable, low, and transparent prices. Apptivity uses a trilogy scheme: users sit at the roof, supported below by affiliators and programmers as the foundation.
about.body2: To help anyone make their work easier through digital solutions — affordable, friendly, and highly effective, for professionals, SMEs, governments, and companies of any size, anywhere.

why.body: Because we help users/clients get the best solution for their needs or problems with the best advice and alternatives — never forcing users/clients into a transaction. But when needed, Apptivity already has qualified and trusted professionals to deliver IT projects of any scale, large or small.

scheme.title: Clients at the peak, carried by two strengths.
scheme.intro: Apptivity runs a win-win trilogy business scheme reflected in our logo: the peak of the trilogy is the satisfaction and fulfillment of our clients' digitalization goals — whom we call friends (sahabat). The strength that holds up that peak is freelance affiliators and developers working in synergy, forming the win-win trilogy.

pillars.name: Client (Sahabat)
pillars.body: Friends are our priority in delivering the best solutions for them.

pillars.name: Affiliator
pillars.body: The front line guiding friends to solve problems with the best solutions at Apptivity.id. There are 2 types: Primary and Regular. A Primary Affiliator is a friend who is also an affiliator, while a Regular Affiliator is anyone connecting friends to us.

pillars.name: Developer
pillars.body: A fast-response team delivering projects according to our friends' needs.

ownership.title: Buy or rent — pick what fits.
ownership.intro: For app ownership we offer 2 options.

pros: Full app ownership with freedom to customize as needed
No charges whatsoever after project close
cons: Any small or large additions beyond the initial agreement incur extra cost
Server rental, domain, and additional tools are not included in the project value

pros: Built-in server and domain rental provided free on Apptivity.id servers and domain
Large additions at a light extra cost
cons: The app is not owned, so it cannot be modified at any time

steps.title: Contact us
steps.body: Users or clients can directly contact the listed number or simply send a Direct Message (DM) to our social media accounts, then we discuss the problem and the best solution.

steps.title: Detail the project
steps.body: If you need Apptivity professionals, you will be connected to discuss the project in detail, up to the contract.

steps.title: Supervised until done
steps.body: All activities are supervised by Apptivity until the project is complete.

steps.title: Money-back guarantee
steps.body: If the project does not match the initial agreement, the user's/client's money is refunded proportionally to the missing features or agreement — and vice versa if there are excess requests.

legal.title: A legal entity, recorded transactions.
legal.body: Apptivity operates under PT Lawson Semesta Indonesia as a single-shareholder company (PT perorangan); as such every transaction and tax is reported and legality is accountable, so all stakeholders need not hesitate about transactions and business through Apptivity.id.

cta.title: Want to ask further? DM and WhatsApp us now — FREE!
cta.sub: Consult first with zero commitment. Tell us your problem, we'll give our best advice and alternatives.
cta.note: Free consultation, 24 hours — replies within 7 hours.

brief.title: Tell us your dream app.
brief.sub: Answer 3 quick steps, then send it straight to our WhatsApp — free, no commitment.

brief.detailPh: E.g.: a cashier app for my store, needs reports and receipts...
